protocol: docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md section 7, proposals P5 and P6
note: This file is committed alone, before the measurement script is run on the scan. Only the scan's envelope, already published in docs/research/wolfe-classics-935-billet-cylinder-head-scan.md, was known when it was written. The private geometry-bearing diagnostics of the 2026-10-29 studies were not consulted.

scan.rights: open-reuse-user-confirmed (catalog/scans/scan-935-xtreme-cylinder-head.json); the raw OBJ stays outside Git
scan.unit: 1 OBJ unit = 1 mm, owner-confirmed project input (docs/research/935-scan-engineering-20261029.md); not physically calibrated

reference.source: Xtreme Cylinder Heads catalogue pages, transcribed in docs/research/935-faithful-replica-20261028/README.md, table 'Manufacturer catalogue data'
reference.evidence: manufacturer catalogue ranges for four head families; the scanned specimen's family is not identified, so the union of the four families is the reference
not_used: Retro Sport head 930 104 048 01, height 84.20-84.21 mm: a different head, cannot calibrate this scan

registration.reason: no documented dimension of this specimen exists to register on; the scale is the owner's declared 1 unit = 1 mm and is not adjusted. This departs from P5 step 3 and is recorded as such.

checks.feature: intake port opening at its flange face
checks.measurand: equivalent diameter sqrt(4A/pi) of the opening's closed section in the flange plane, A from the section polygon; a least-squares circle diameter is reported beside it
checks.reference_basis: published intake-port size, union of the four families (35-42, 35-44, 40-47, 40-47)
checks.pass_rule: 35.0 - T <= value <= 47.0 + T for every intake port found
checks.failure_means: the scan, its declared unit or the family attribution contradicts the catalogue; recorded as a contradiction, not corrected

checks.feature: exhaust port opening at its flange face
checks.reference_basis: published exhaust-port size, union of the four families (35-39, 35-41, 36-41.5, 36-41.5)
checks.pass_rule: 35.0 - T <= value <= 41.5 + T for every exhaust port found

checks.measurand: least-squares circle diameter of the bore in a section normal to its axis, at least 3 mm below its opening
checks.reference_basis: published spark-plug size 12 or 14 mm, read as M12x1.25 or M14x1.25 threads: a scanned threaded bore lies between the minor diameter of M12x1.25 (10.647 mm) and the major diameter of M14x1.25 (14.0 mm); the thread pitch is the repository's reading, not the catalogue's

checks.measurand: least-squares circle diameter in a section normal to the guide axis
checks.reference_basis: published 8 mm intake and exhaust stems; a guide bore is at least the stem diameter, the running clearance is not published

outcomes.pass: every instance of the feature found meets the pass rule
outcomes.fail: at least one instance found violates the pass rule
outcomes.not_observable: the scan holds no closed section of the feature that the stated method can identify; this is a result, not a pass

fixed_rules: No rescaling, re-registration or dropped check after results are seen.
Every instance found is reported, with its section plane.

Feature identification (which opening is intake, exhaust, plug or guide) is done by geometry and written down with its reasoning; it may use views of the scan made after this commit, and that is stated in the results.
A pass shows the scan agrees with a manufacturer range at T; it is not a calibration, an accuracy statement or a measurement of the specimen.
